title: Made a 1v1 perk-draft autobattler with Claude + GPT, would love feedback!
author: Nyaken
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I'd like to show you **Cobratoxan**, a free 1v1 autobattler I've been building with AI for the last two months

**The game:**

* 3 rounds of **blind perk draft**: both players pick at the same time and only see each other's picks after the round
* then the fighters battle **on their own**, so your build matters, not your reflexes
* **online ranked** (Glicko-2), lobby chat and in-fight taunts, bots for practice

**Who did what:**

* **Claude:** all the code. Godot game client, battle simulation, headless game server, account and chat services (Python + Postgres in Docker), tests, builds and animation. 
* **GPT and other AI tools:** art, backgrounds, UI, icons.
* **Music** is not AI yet: Cloudkicker.

Right now there are 45 perks. Next up: PvE task bar system, team fights and roughly a thousand more perks 😅

It's still early, so expect bugs and weird balance. Any feedback is welcome, on the game itself or on building it with AI!

🎮 Play free: [https://dukenyaken.itch.io/cobratoxan](https://dukenyaken.itch.io/cobratoxan)
